# Thumbnails and screenshots

This page is for developers and designers who give a site package its picture. The thumbnail is the first thing an
administrator sees of a site package: the setup wizard shows it beside every site package it offers, and the
package page shows it next to the details. **No thumbnail is enforced**; without one the wizard shows a default
picture. Every shipped site package has one, and the package server carries a copy for the index.

2. [Where the setup wizard takes the picture from](#where-the-setup-wizard-takes-the-picture-from)

## The thumbnail in package.xml

A thumbnail is a file list of type `thumbnail` in the file collection named `default`:

```xml
<files>
  <collection name="default">
    <file-list type="thumbnail" variable-name="thumbnail">
      <file name="thumbnail.png" md5sum="77a7bc0cc6e1e5138ca7a6e39a130307" />
    </file-list>
  </collection>
</files>
```

The file goes in the archive at `files/<collection>/<type>/<name>`, so here
`files/default/thumbnail/thumbnail.png` (`eZPackage::fileItemPath()` in `kernel/classes/ezpackage.php`). Two
details are fixed by the code:

- The collection must be `default`. The `thumbnail-list` attribute of a package is `thumbnailList( 'default' )`, so a
  thumbnail in any other collection is never shown.
- Only the **first** thumbnail is used, by the setup wizard and by the package page alike.

The `md5sum` attribute is read and written back, but nothing that imports or installs a package checks it against
the file. Keep it correct anyway: it is the only record of which picture the definition was written for.

## Where the setup wizard takes the picture from

The site type step (`kernel/setup/steps/ezstep_site_types.php`, template
`design/standard/templates/setup/init/site_types.tpl`) picks one picture per site package, in this order:

| Order | Source | When |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The package's own first thumbnail (`thumbnail_path`) | The package is already imported on this installation |
| 2 | `thumbnail_url` of the package's entry in `index.xml` | The package is only on the package server, and (from 6.0.15 on) the address is `http://` or `https://` |
| 3 | `design/standard/images/setup/eZ_setup_template_default.png` | Neither exists |

So the same package can show two different pictures: the server's before it is imported and its own afterwards.
The 7x source repository recorded the fix for that on 2026-10-02:

```text
Updated: The multisite packages carry the Exponential multisite picture as their thumbnail, the one the package server shows for them, so the setup wizard shows the same picture for a package it already has as for one it would download.
```

## The thumbnail on the package server

Each site package entry of the 6.0.15 `index.xml` has a `thumbnail_url` of the form
`https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/thumbnails/<name>.png`, for example
[thumbnails/sevenx_multisite.png](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/thumbnails/sevenx_multisite.png).
The `thumbnails/` folder of that release holds 13 PNG files: one for each of the 12 site packages in the index,
and `sevenx_site_paypal.png`, which no index entry uses. The attribute format is on
[The index.xml format](../package-server/the-index-xml-format.md).

## The image file list

The 7x and CJW site packages carry a second picture, `logo.png`, as a file list of type `image` in the same
collection, stored at `files/default/image/logo.png`:

```xml
<file-list type="image" variable-name="image">
  <file name="logo.png" md5sum="999280c75d36e8e24477c223a3230906" />
</file-list>
```

None of the setup wizard steps in `kernel/setup/steps/` reads it; it is a convention of the shipped packages. The
package page lists it among the package's files.

## What the shipped packages carry

Checked on 2026-10-18 in the source repositories and the package server repository:

| Package | Thumbnail | Size | Same as the server's copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sevenx_multisite`, `sevenx_multisite_clean`, `cjw_multisite` | `thumbnail.png` | 192 x 192 PNG | yes |
| `sevenx_site` | `thumbnail.png` | 120 x 103 PNG | yes |
| `sevenx_site_clean` | `thumbnail.png` | 120 x 103 PNG | no, the server's copy differs |
| `sevenx_design_blue`, `sevenx_design_cleangray`, `sevenx_design_gray` | `thumbnail.png` | 120 x 103 PNG | no server copy (site styles are not listed with a thumbnail) |

All five site packages also carry `logo.png` (176 x 42 PNG). In `sevenx_multisite` and `sevenx_multisite_clean`
the `md5sum` written for `logo.png` did not match the file, which shows how quietly such a value goes stale. Fixed
on 2026-10-19: both packages now state the file's checksum, and the rebuilt packages are on the package server.

The three site styles `sevenx_design_blue`, `sevenx_design_cleangray` and `sevenx_design_gray` still carry stale
checksums for their `thumbnail.png`, `site-colors.css` and `classes-colors.css` (checked by importing them on
2026-10-19). In `sevenx_design_gray` the two stylesheets are empty files, so its checksums are not the only thing
to look at before that package is changed.

## Screenshots

A package has no field for screenshots. The thumbnail is a small picture for choosing; it is not a preview of the
site. Put screenshots of a site package where people decide whether to use it: in the README of its source
repository, and in the pull request that submits it ([Contribute your site package](../contribute-your-site-package.md)).
Taking them well is covered by [Screenshots for a theme](../../designers/distribution/screenshots-for-a-theme.md) and
the [Screenshot checklist](../../designers/distribution/screenshot-checklist.md).

## Checklist

- [ ] One PNG thumbnail in the `default` collection, at `files/default/thumbnail/thumbnail.png`.
- [ ] 192 x 192 like the multisite packages, or 120 x 103 like the classic ones.
- [ ] The `md5sum` in `package.xml` matches: `md5sum files/default/thumbnail/thumbnail.png`.
- [ ] The same picture, byte for byte, as `thumbnails/<name>.png` on the package server.
- [ ] `thumbnail_url` in the index entry points at that file and answers 200.
- [ ] Screenshots in the source repository's README, not in the package.

```bash
md5sum files/default/thumbnail/thumbnail.png
grep -A2 'type="thumbnail"' package.xml
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://packages.example.com/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/thumbnails/example_site.png
```
